name: Stereoscopic Projection Constraints
aliases: Fast Stereoscopic Volume Rendering with Left-to-Right Projection Constraints
Fast stereoscopic images with ray-traced volume rendering
definition: A method to generate stereoscopic volume rendering pairs by calculating the left-eye view first, projecting its accumulated samples to the right-eye view, and constraining the right-eye ray traversal to only evaluate voxels that are guaranteed to be visible based on the left-eye results, thereby avoiding redundant voxel evaluations in occluded regions.
summary: Stereoscopic Projection Constraints is a fast volume rendering method that generates stereo pairs by using left-eye results to constrain right-eye ray traversal, avoiding redundant voxel evaluations in occluded regions.
